title: AuditEvent
description: One line of runs/<run_id>/run.log.jsonl. Reads are logged, not only writes, because what did it touch has to be a query. Code-only events (scrub, verify, score, write, commit, read) carry null model_tier, model_id and prompt_hash and zero token and cost fields. tokens_in excludes cache reads and cache writes, matching the API usage block. detail is free form and is the only object in the pack with additionalProperties true; it must never contain raw source text or a PII value.

schema_version.description: Contract version of this document. Bump minor for an additive change, major for a breaking one.

agent.description: gong_reader, sfdc_reader, editor, analyst, or the code component name such as connectors, scrubber, verifier, scorer, renderer, store, gate, pipeline.

stage.description: Fixed stage name, used for the cost table.

target.description: What was acted on: a source_id, a theme_id, a file path, a schema name.

model_id.description: Resolved from config at call time. Present only on call_model events.

detail.description: Free form context. Never raw source text, never a PII value.
